title: The Hold
setting_summary: An aging cargo ship named the Hold drifts in a decaying orbit, its crew rationing air, water, and patience while a corporate salvage deadline ticks down. Every decision gets logged by a shipboard system that rewards compliance and quietly punishes dissent, and the only thing scarcer than supplies is the benefit of the doubt.
